{{CorrectTitle|Tallaan spacedock #473B}}
'''Tallaan spacedock #473B''' was part of the [[Tallaani Shipyards]]. The [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Knumai]] met with independent [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] at the spacedock, under the guise of a regular cargo transfer. Knumai supplied the spacers with five [[transcube]]s of equipment provided to them by [[House Cadriaan]] for a mission to infiltrate the [[Vor-cal Feast]] aboard the [[House Melantha Orbital Hunting Lodge]] over [[Vycinyth]].<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
